scope: correction to Step84 T-symmetry chirality labels

correction.wrong_step84_statement: S0 is anti-holomorphic on first factor, reverses chirality at A-nodes
correction.correct_statement: S0 and S2 are complex-linear homogeneous-coordinate sign changes in CP^4, hence holomorphic projective automorphisms of each fiber. They are not anti-holomorphic on the del Pezzo surface.
correction.effect_on_matched_KE_control: The G=<T,S0,S2> equivariant all-same-chirality KE degeneration remains compatible with the algebraic complex smoothing. The verified killing of continuous holomorphic vector fields is therefore useful evidence for an equivariant Spotti/Tian control argument.
correction.effect_on_mixed_chirality: The mixed-chirality Riemannian construction still uses the separate orientation-reversing L symmetry from Step81; it is not supplied by the complex G-equivariant del Pezzo smoothing.

status: Step84 numerical symmetry and automorphism-kernel results are retained; only the holomorphic/chirality interpretation of S0,S2 is corrected.
